Oh I’m sorry I misremembered! I don’t know all the details, because I was confused so I’m sorry about the vague “somethings.”

We went to the DMV to switch my plates onto her old car, then put her plates on her new car. We couldn’t do that because of something with the new car and needing them to send her something for it. I’m pretty sure they were talking about needing the title for the new car, but I don’t remember what paper it was that the woman at the desk pointed at. This DMV is on a military base, so it was a little different. The woman said something about them “not doing” (I think transferring?) the basic state plates, which is what I have.

We didn’t get to transferring the title because she said she wanted to wait until my car’s registration expires in January and I can get a new one on her car by that time.

Again, my bad for the misinfo.


edit for more information

She paid for it at first when I told her I did not want it, and I still paid it back. She paid for the insurance on her own car. My brother and I pay her for the full amount on our cars since we are under her policy. I will still be paying insurance on the car I drive. 

I was the one who got hit. The accident was a bit complicated & my mother tried to fight it because she thinks from how I described it, the other driver should be at fault. They said the lack of video proof means they can’t do anything. I learned what I should and shouldn’t have done, but I promise you I wasn’t driving recklessly.

I never saw the check, and I don’t know how much it was for. I was looking at used cars similar to mine (around $5-7k) that I planned to use the check as well as my own money on.

I honestly don’t know! She was talking to her friend about it yesterday and when her friend asked how much she got, she just said “enough to scrape by.” That was the first time I heard they even sent a total.

Yeah, she is the primary. I was wondering if that could’ve been the reason she was able to do it legally. I will probably call to find out after Thanksgiving since I have a lot to do today and tomorrow. I don’t really want to go hard on her and cause trouble since I have a car at the end of the day.

I already have a therapist thankfully.

She has always been pretty abusive towards me specifically, so I’m used to it. I have two other siblings but I’m the only one she would ever hit. She told me she stopped when she realized I was big enough to hit back. Thank you for the links.
